title: Speech evaluation transcripts
description: The final transcripts one arm of a speech evaluation run returned for every file of one pool of a corpus, scored by tools/validation/speech_quality.py against the references of the corpus manifest it names. The streaming arm is the product's speech session; the batch arm decodes each whole file with the same model and configuration.

manifest_sha256.description: Of the corpus manifest file's bytes.

clips.description: One entry per file of the pool, speech and silence alike.

finals.description: Every final transcript of the file, in order; none for a file that ended without one.

oneOf.description: A file whose run ended in an error. It is scored as an empty prediction and counted as a runtime failure.
